title: Parking Lot
summary: Design a parking lot system for a multi-level garage that assigns spots to vehicles of different sizes, tracks availability, and calculates a fee when the vehicle leaves.
requirements: Support multiple vehicle types (motorcycle, car, bus) with different spot size requirements.
Assign an available spot to an entering vehicle and free it when the vehicle leaves.
Track how many spots are free, per level and per spot size.
Calculate a parking fee based on how long the vehicle stayed.
Handle the case where the lot (or a needed spot size) is full.
constraints: The lot has multiple levels, each with a fixed number of spots of each size.
A bus can only park in a large spot; a motorcycle can park in any spot size.
Assume a single entry/exit gate per level for this design.
